description: Answers every book check and warning over the open DIYA-GL book, each with its verdict (pass, warn or fail), what it means and the entryNumbers of the lines that fail it, with the pass, warn and fail counts. Use this when the person asks whether anything is wrong with their records, which entries fall outside the year, which sales have no invoice number, whether there are duplicates, or how near they are to the VAT threshold. It does not change the book or contact HMRC.
name: checks
title: Check a DIYA-GL book
